name: Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
title: Gala Precision Engineering Ltd - 544244 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Chennai fastener plant ramping from ~35% utilisation toward INR80cr FY27 (67-70% of INR120cr capacity) while Phase 2 adds capacity; margins dipped to 16.5% on INR3.23cr forex loss, with price pass-through lag.

utilisation.quote: During FY26, the plant operated at around 35% utilization and we expect utilization level to improve meaningfully in FY26.

capex.quote: for the current year, we are seeing approximately INR50 crores something we may be able to deploy plus minus depend when we finalize the land

triggers.label: Chennai utilisation ~35% FY26 → ~67-70% FY27
triggers.quote: approximately INR80 crores something will be achieving the manufacturing or sale value in next year, which is going to be approximately 67% 70% of INR120 crores

triggers.label: Phase 2 capex adds INR120cr capacity
triggers.quote: that again will add another 5 crores per month capacity or annual capacity of additional 60 crores

triggers.label: Inventory days 103, target cut ~10 days
triggers.quote: overall inventory level are at 103 days and we see it should not go above 103 days

triggers.label: Pass-through lag; price talks from April
triggers.quote: we already started discussion since beginning of April itself

guidance.quote: we are looking to grow 20% to 25% sector in overall revenue term
we are seeing approximately INR80 crores something will be achieving
we expect the margins to stabilize between 17% to 19%
export will continue to be between 35% to 40% of our sales
we will maintain or we will try to improve by 10% or 10% or so on year-on-year

red_flags.label: Chennai plant at ~35% utilisation FY26
red_flags.quote: During FY26, the plant operated at around 35% utilization

red_flags.label: Forex loss INR3.23cr hit margins; cash flow constrained by inventory build
red_flags.quote: the drop is essentially mainly is on account of the forex loss, which is almost 1%, which is around INR3.23 crores

evasions.quote: I don't have the exact numbers; I will just answer that separately.
So, we are quite close to in closing this land, but still not close, that is the fact.
